review.notes: Full review at the head the previous review read. Seeded sample (1.1, 2.1, 3.1) and both source locators (ChienWaldron2016 Thm 2.2(1) pp. 4-5 and (1.1) p. 2) verified against the text; every Check and example recomputed; 23 library names confirmed by #check at the pins; Suggested.lean elaborates with no error or warning; the statements of 1.1 and 3.1 elaborated in probe copies and tested with one tactic (1.1 and Parseval are not one-tactic and not in the library; the summability criterion is one term). Automatic checks all passed; depcheck 0 problems; nothing changed outside the folder. One P2: the roadmap's own headline theorems (1.1 expansion, 3.1 Parseval) are statable at the pins but absent from Suggested.lean, whose docstring calls the Tau Ceti theorems the headlines; the previous review's C01 (Convention 8) is the same defect and is not counted separately. Two questions for the human reviewers (scope, Kitware copyright line).
